thread:
anya: Heads-up: tenant 'beta-inc' reported failed SCIM writes after yesterday's RBAC rename. Getting '403 permission_denied' then clients retry and hit throttles. Anyone digging in? :mag:

tom: Looking now. Edge logs show `authz: deny` for principal svc-beta-scim -> expected role now 'scim.writer' but principal still has 'scim.push'.

nate: Was there a KMS operation too? I faintly remember a scheduled rewrap last night.

ops-bot: infra: kms-rewrap job completed at 6279989000, alias=redwood-scim-prod rewrapped to new-key-id by infra@ops :white_check_mark:

anya: The sequence matches. First authz denies ~6279989400, then retries flood until throttled. But there are also intermittent KMS AccessDenied in the same window for svc-beta-scim.

tom: Paste of one trace snippet:
```
[scim] trace=trc-e7c2 principal=svc-beta-scim authz:deny reason='role_mismatch:scim.writer'
[crypto] trace=trc-e7c2 kms:Decrypt AccessDenied user=svc-beta-scim key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
```

nate: Looks like two independent failures colliding: role rename missing principal update + KMS policy tightness on the service principal. Both cause retries. Client-side retry is naive (no jitter) so token bucket exhausted and we return 429. We should short-circuit to 403 if authz fails.

anya: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) enable temporary mapping of scim.push -> scim.writer for tenants that still reference old role (feature-flag) 2) add an exponential backoff + jitter on SCIM client SDKs (quick PR) 3) whitelist svc-beta-scim in KMS key policy for the new CMK id (ops will do) 4) clear tenant throttle counters for beta-inc to avoid residual blocking.

tom: I'll open a backfill job to patch principals missing scim.writer and mark it high priority.

nate: I'll update KMS key policy and add a smoke test that performs a SCIM create+decrypt as part of post-rotate checks. I'll coordinate with infra.

ops-bot: action: cleared quota for tenant id=tn-beta-09 at 6279990100 by ops@rate-limits :ok_hand:

audit-bot: audit: role-rename event by rbac-service at 6279988800 {actor: infra-bot, change: scim.push->scim.writer, rollout: staged} https://audit.internal/events/6279988800

anya: After mapping enabled, error rate dropped drastically. Still watching for any KMS decrypt failures. Will keep thread open for 1 hour then file a short postmortem with timeline + recommend "rename window" checklist.

tom: Also adding a doc note: when renaming RBAC roles, run identity-store backfill before KMS rewraps or vice versa, and have a cross-check smoke test. I'll draft RFC.

nate: Forensics: collect a sample of trace ids with both authz deny + kms AccessDenied and attach to PM. We might need to loosen the key policy temporarily if backfill is slow.

anya: Thanks everyone. Closing after monitor window if green.
